title: The Interior Where Future Salt Gathers

features.name: the vigil
features.desc-on-touch: You stand where salt crystals have stopped their slow accumulation. A pool of brine reflects the rust-colored sky, patient and waiting.

features.name: salt towers
features.desc-on-touch: Mineral deposits have built themselves into irregular stacks, each one recording a season of waiting. They hum with the archive's own frequency.

features.name: diary shelf
features.desc-on-touch: A kept record of daily measurements, each entry shorter than the last—the paper smells of salt and old time. You remember who wrote it without reading the name.

features.name: heat shimmer
features.desc-on-touch: The air wavers over the salt fields, distorting the distance. For a moment you see a place that might not exist.

features.name: mineral bed
features.desc-on-touch: The crust forms an arch over deeper brine chambers. Step through, and you are walking on the boundary between solid and solution.

inscription: the salt remembers when it was future, not yet mineral

file.note: A keeper's daily record of salt crystals forming in a landlocked depression. Entries grow shorter. Salt knows patience.

reverie.title: REVERIE — salt-keeping at dusk
narr: You sit at the salt's edge where it's stopped growing.
Katita kneels, fingers in the crust, tasting its weight.
"It tastes like time that never arrived," she says.
You watch her hand settle back in the grains.
Some waiting is the realest work.
